The main tree has the same missing files, so I don't think my change causes it.

- **Deviation:** I did not touch `Page.class.js`, so `AISessionDetail.js` does its own subpage linking and parts drawing.
- **Not done:** the "fresh Haiku builds a page from the descriptions alone" test is still to do, and the doc says so.
- **Cleanup for you:** the proof worktree and its server on port 55471 are still running. Remove them with `node Server/worktree-down.mjs page-ai-api-proof`.

The report is `public/framework/ai/2026-10-12/page-ai-api/build/report.md`, with the probe script and two screenshots beside it.
